title: ID0427000-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R7 313065117139] Charging session is abruptly interrupted
description:
The charging session is abruptly interrupted on the charger.
We receive the following error:
DC1: Outlet not ready – EVSE not in operating mode run, mode: 0 → 9
After this, the device shuts itself down. This issue started occurring after the v7.0.5 firmware update.
The log data is attached. We kindly request a detailed analysis.

ID0427000-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R7 313065117139] Charging session is abruptly interrupted CRM:00798002169
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre,
We have investigated the charger and charging sessions.
Also, Notes been added from your side.  Thanks for same.
We have observed there is issue with Temp & fan in the charger. We need to check/troubleshoot as per following instructions.
First of all,
Currently, We have issue of CanCommLoss over one of the converter.
We need to identify the converter from the missing serial number and check by replacing it with adjacent one to ascertain if it is CAN wiring issue or the converter issue.
We recommend having spare converter while site intervention.
We have observed BT2 alarms in logs,
"VIN:" → sensor value is invalid: true if one of the following conditions is in error
"ORI:" → sensor reading is outside the defined operation limit
We need to investigate if the temperature is actually increasing or sensor is malfunctioning.
We need to check for the resistance across BT2 sensor. It should be as per PT1000 temp vs resistance table.
We recommend having spares while site intervention.
For investigating BT1 & BT2, We need to check the voltage between (I2 and Ground) and it should be comparable between (I8 and Ground)
Similarly, We need to check the voltage between (I1 and Ground) and it should be comparable between (I7 and Ground)
Also, We have observed the GQ1 Error Flag.
For GQ1 Fan Error,
Pls refer KA
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_FAN_Error Flag_OK Signal Lost -
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled -
